subject: Interested in Redwood demo — HealthSync signup
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@healthsync.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood demo — HealthSync signup

Hi Marissa,

I signed up for a trial earlier today after seeing Redwood's benchmarks for inference latency — thanks for making that public. We're HealthSync (healthcare integrations) and I'm evaluating inference providers for a conversational triage assistant we're building. A few details up front:

- Primary use case: clinical intake + triage routing (structured output + basic triage logic)
- Current monthly volume: ~200k API calls/month, spiking to ~350k for campaigns
- Timeline: pilot in Q4, production H1 2027
- Must be HIPAA-ready; procurement will need SOC2 and audit logs

Would love a quick product demo and to understand pricing/throughput options. I'm based in Pacific Time — available most afternoons next week.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform, HealthSync
alex.johnson@healthsync.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@healthsync.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood demo — HealthSync signup

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for signing up.

Quick intro: I'm Marissa on the inbound SDR team and Jonas (cc) is the AE who'll run the technical demo with you. We can definitely cover HIPAA readiness, SOC2 artifacts, and audit/logging in the session. To help us tailor the demo, could you confirm a couple quick items?

1) Expected peak concurrency or tokens/sec during spikes (ballpark is fine)
2) Any specific integrations (EHR vendors, HL7/FHIR pipelines) we should touch on?
3) Who else from your team should join the demo (technical reviewer, procurement)?

I have 30-minute slots open next week — please pick whichever works:
- Tue Jul 13 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Wed Jul 14 3:30–4:00 PM PT
- Thu Jul 15 10:00–10:30 AM PT

Or use my calendar link: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/redwood-demo-30m

I've attached a short demo brief so you know what we'll cover.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Inbound SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-demo-brief.pdf (1 page — agenda + checklist)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@healthsync.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mark.chen@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood demo — HealthSync signup

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick reply. Answers below:

1) Peak concurrency: roughly 40–60 concurrent requests during business hours; tokens/sec varies but peak tokenize rate ~1.2k tokens/sec during campaigns.
2) Integrations: we pull from FHIR stores and a Kafka pipeline; want to see how Redwood would sit behind an internal service that enriches FHIR resources before calling the model.
3) Attendees: I'll join plus our CTO Mark Chen (cc'd) and our lead infra engineer (I'll confirm name). Procurement may join later — target decision by end of Q3.

Any of the Tue/Wed/Thu slots you proposed work for us — prefer Tue Jul 13 at 2:00 PM PT.

Also attaching a brief RFI we're running through procurement so you have the high-level questions in advance.

Thanks,
Alex

Attachment: healthsync-rfi.pdf

Perfect — Tue Jul 13 2:00 PM PT is confirmed. I've invited Jonas for the demo and he'll lead a short technical walkthrough (20m) followed by Q&A.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=healthsync-demo-20260712
If anything changes, reply here and we'll reschedule.

Prep for the call:
- Jonas will demo model routing, batching, and how we expose audit logs for compliance.
- Please have any sample FHIR snippets to hand if you want a live sketch of the flow.

Look forward to it — talk Tuesday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
